answer: Session keys rotate every 30 days and only a finished task renews them, so a dormant account loses signing rights and its history stops counting, while rewards vest over 12 epochs. Numbers: 1,000 idle accounts need 1,000 tasks a month, about 300 grader hours. An echo of an old key in a new epoch is rejected at the door, and a nebula of shared sessions collapses to one device. Revoked keys sit on a sable list.
